[
رَسُوبِىٌّ and ↓ مُتَرَسِّبٌ , terms used by Ibn-Seenà, are explained by Golius as meaning Having, or depositing, a sediment: but the former rather means having the nature of dregs, or sediment: and the latter, becoming, or that becomes, precipitated.]
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
